The Imo State Police Command has said a serial kidnapper, rapist and armed robber, Olisamaka Umah, who had been on its wanted list, has been arrested. This was disclosed in a statement signed by the Force Public Relations Officer, Ani Iniedu, and posted on the Nigeria Police Force’s X page on Friday. It read, “Operatives of the Anti-Kidnapping Unit, in synergy with Agwa Police Division, acted on credible intelligence to arrest a serial kidnapper, Olisamaka Umah (29), of Umuoma Irete, Owerri West LGA. “The suspect, who had been on the command’s wanted list, confessed during interrogation to featuring prominently in several cases of kidnapping, armed robbery, and the rape of female victims. “He has named fleeing gang members, whom operatives are actively tracking down to bring the entire syndicate to justice.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. According to a statement by the police, two firearms and other stolen items were recovered from the suspects. The statement read, “Operatives on stop-and-search duty at NASFAT Area, EiyeKorin, intercepted a commercial bus, leading to the arrest of Abdulahi Olamilekan (20), who jumped out and attempted to flee. “A ringing phone found on him revealed a robbery at Al-Hikmah University hostels. Further investigations led to the arrest of three accomplices: Jimoh Abdulfatai (28), Abdulahi Bashir (29), and Tunji Abel. “The four suspects (all ex-convicts) confessed to robbing the university hostels three times in the past. Police recovered two locally crafted pistols, one live cartridge, eight mobile phones, and a laptop. They have been positively identified by the victims.” Victor Ayeni Victor is a Senior Correspondent at Punch Newspapers’ Features Desk with over ten years of experience as a writer and blogger.
